title: Punishment for Murder
description: Anyone who commits murder shall face life imprisonment or death penalty depending on severity.

title: Punishment for Rape
description: Whoever commits rape faces rigorous imprisonment and fine.

title: Cheating and Fraud
description: Cheating or dishonest fraud for personal gain is punishable by imprisonment and fine.

title: Voluntarily Causing Hurt
description: Causing simple physical harm to someone is punishable by up to 1 year imprisonment or fine.

title: Hurt with Dangerous Weapons
description: Causing hurt using weapons is punishable by imprisonment and fine.

title: Causing Grievous Hurt
description: Serious injury caused intentionally is punishable with imprisonment up to 10 years.

title: Outraging Modesty of a Woman
description: Assault or force intended to outrage a woman's modesty is punishable by imprisonment.

title: Cruelty by Husband or Relatives
description: Any physical or mental cruelty by husband or in-laws is punishable.

title: Criminal Intimidation
description: Threatening someone with harm is punishable by imprisonment or fine.

title: Acts Done by Several Persons
description: When several people commit a crime together, each is liable as if they acted alone.

title: Attempt to Murder
description: An attempt to kill someone is punishable by up to life imprisonment.

title: Theft
description: Taking someone's property without consent is punishable.

title: Theft in Dwelling House
description: Theft committed inside a house is punished more severely.

title: Robbery
description: Robbery is punishable by rigorous imprisonment.

title: Arrest Without Warrant
description: Police can arrest without warrant in certain serious offences.

title: FIR Registration
description: Police must register FIR for cognizable offences.

title: Judicial Custody Rules
description: Defines how long a person can be detained before chargesheet.

title: Criminal Conspiracy
description: Planning or agreeing to commit a crime is punishable.

title: Insulting a Woman's Modesty
description: Words or gestures intended to insult a woman are punishable.

title: Hurting Religious Sentiments
description: Deliberately insulting religion is a punishable offence.

title: Valid Contracts
description: A contract is valid if both parties agree and meet legal requirements.

title: Compensation for Breach
description: A person harmed due to breach of contract can claim compensation.

title: Recovery of Possession
description: You can recover property that is illegally occupied.

title: Quick Possession Recovery
description: A simple process to get back possession taken without consent.

title: Temporary Injunctions
description: Court can stop someone from harming or altering property.

title: Civil Court Jurisdiction
description: Civil courts can hear all suits unless barred by law.

title: Legal Notice to Government
description: Notice must be given before suing the government.

title: Time Limits for Cases
description: A case filed after legal time limits cannot be accepted.

title: Right of Easement
description: People can have rights such as right of way through another's land.

title: Family Court Jurisdiction
description: Family courts handle marriage, divorce, and custody cases.

title: Divorce Grounds
description: Marriage can be dissolved for reasons such as cruelty, abandonment, or adultery.

title: Maintenance During Case
description: Either spouse can claim financial support during divorce proceedings.

title: Daughter's Equal Rights
description: Daughters have equal rights in ancestral property.

title: Definition of Domestic Violence
description: Covers physical, verbal, emotional, and economic abuse.
reference: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005

title: Complaint Procedure
description: Women can file domestic violence complaints for protection and relief.
reference: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005

title: Eligibility for Adoption
description: Defines who can legally adopt a child.

title: Compensation for Accidents
description: Victims of road accidents can claim compensation.

title: Drunk Driving Rules
description: Punishes driving under alcohol beyond permitted limits.

title: Sale of Immovable Property
description: A property sale requires a registered document.

title: Lease of Property
description: Defines leasing, rent, and tenancy rights.

title: Right to Equality
description: Everyone is equal before law and protected from discrimination.

title: No Discrimination
description: Discrimination based on religion, race, caste, sex, or birth is prohibited.

title: Freedom of Speech
description: Every citizen has the right to freely express opinions.

title: Right to Assembly
description: Citizens can peacefully gather without arms.

title: Right to Life
description: Every person has a right to live with dignity.

title: Protection from Illegal Arrest
description: Arrested persons must be informed of charges and allowed legal help.

title: Prohibition of Trafficking
description: Human trafficking and forced labor are banned.

title: Child Labor Protection
description: Children cannot work in hazardous industries.

title: Freedom of Religion
description: People are free to practice any religion.

title: Cultural Protection
description: Communities can preserve their languages and culture.

title: Minority Education Rights
description: Minorities can run their own educational institutions.

title: Right to Constitutional Remedies
description: People can approach the Supreme Court to protect fundamental rights.

title: Free Legal Aid
description: Poor citizens must get free legal help.

title: Public Health Duty
description: State must improve public health and nutrition.

title: Right to Education
description: Free and compulsory education for children aged 6–14.

title: Protection in Convictions
description: No one can be punished twice for the same offence.

title: Equality in Public Employment
description: Equal opportunity for all in government jobs.

title: Abolition of Untouchability
description: Untouchability in any form is prohibited.

title: Abolition of Titles
description: State shall not confer titles except for military or academic honors.

title: Freedom from Religious Instruction
description: No compulsory religious teaching in government schools.

title: Definition of Consumer
description: Anyone who buys goods or services for use is a consumer.

title: Consumer Complaint
description: Consumers can file complaints against unfair practices.

title: District Commission
description: District commission handles complaints up to ₹1 crore.

title: State Commission
description: Handles complaints above district level.

title: Right to Compensation
description: Consumers can claim compensation for losses.

title: E-Filing
description: Consumers can file complaints online.

title: MRP Protection
description: No shopkeeper can sell goods above MRP.

title: Safe Food
description: Food sellers must ensure food is safe and hygienic.

title: False Food Claims
description: False or misleading food claims are punishable.

title: Refund and Replacement
description: Consumers can seek refunds for defective products.

title: Digital Payment Protection
description: Banks must refund unauthorized digital transaction losses.

title: Quality Certification
description: Products should follow BIS quality standards.

title: Telecom Consumer Rights
description: Consumers can complain about network or billing issues.

title: Protection from Unfair Trade
description: Shops cannot cheat or mislead customers.

title: Unfair Contract Terms
description: Unreasonable contract terms can be struck down.

title: Ban on Fake Medicines
description: Selling fake or expired medicines is punishable.

title: Product Liability
description: Manufacturers are responsible for faulty products.

title: E-Commerce Rules
description: Online sellers must display full product details.

title: Liability of Service Providers
description: Service providers must ensure quality service.

title: Penalty for Misleading Ads
description: Celebrities and companies can be penalized for misleading ads.

title: Transfer of Property
description: Defines how property can be legally transferred.

title: Sale of Immovable Property
description: Sale of land requires a registered deed.

title: Lis Pendens
description: Property cannot be sold while a court case about it is ongoing.

title: Lease
description: Explains rent, tenancy, and lease agreements.

title: Tenant Rights
description: Defines rights and duties of tenants and landlords.

title: Compulsory Registration
description: Property documents must be registered to be valid.

title: Stamp Duty
description: Property documents require stamp duty payment.

title: Coparcenary Rights
description: Daughters have equal property rights.

title: Ban on Benami Property
description: Buying property in someone else's name to hide identity is illegal.

title: Compensation for Land Acquisition
description: Owners are entitled to fair market compensation.

title: Project Registration
description: Builders must register real estate projects.

title: Builder Duties
description: Builders must provide clear property details.

title: Refund for Delay
description: Buyers can get refunds if possession is delayed.

title: Possession Suit
description: People can sue to recover property possession.

title: Division of Property
description: Co-owners can seek court partition.

title: Feed the Grant
description: Invalid property sales may become valid later.

title: Rent Regulation
description: Regulates eviction and rent increases.

title: Homebuyer Rights
description: Buyers can demand possession, refund, or compensation.

title: Urban Land Limits
description: Restricts excessive land holding in cities.

title: Forest Dweller Property Rights
description: Recognizes land rights of traditional forest dwellers.

title: Computer-Related Offences
description: Hacking or damaging computer systems is punishable.

title: Identity Theft
description: Using someone’s digital identity without permission is illegal.

title: Online Impersonation
description: Cheating someone via fake identity online is punishable.

title: Obscene Online Content
description: Publishing obscene content online is punishable.

title: Sexually Explicit Content
description: Uploading sexually explicit content is illegal.

title: Government Monitoring
description: Government may intercept data under lawful conditions.

title: Unauthorized Access
description: Accessing systems without permission leads to penalties.

title: Data Protection
description: Companies must protect user data.

title: False Digital Certificates
description: Providing false information for digital certificates is punishable.

title: Breach of Confidentiality
description: Revealing private information without consent is illegal.

title: Data Misuse by Service Providers
description: Service providers cannot misuse stored data.

title: Cyber Terrorism
description: Acts threatening national security using computers are punishable.

title: Child Sexual Content
description: Uploading child sexual content online is strictly punishable.

title: Tampering Computer Source Code
description: Altering system source code illegally is punishable.

title: Extraterritorial Jurisdiction
description: Cybercrime outside India affecting India can be penalized.

title: Corporate Liability
description: Companies are responsible for cyber offences committed by employees.

title: Social Media Compliance
description: Large platforms must follow strict data and grievance rules.

title: Digital Media Rules
description: Online publishers must follow code of ethics.

title: Online Banking Security
description: Banks must protect users from cyber fraud.

title: Cyber Incident Reporting
description: Companies must report major cyber attacks to CERT-In.
